provenance.note: Palakkad district's rivers, reservoirs, wetlands and groundwater (scope palakkad-rivers; the district's own scope id is kl-palakkad). The district is the union of its local bodies in KSREC's layer and the catchments (shedId) are the river basins of KSREC's watershed atlas cut to it. KSREC publishes no licence and its layers are served with attribution; its quarry layer is OpenStreetMap's (ODbL).
